items.title: N-type semiconductor ka banna (print mein 2.11.2) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the topic printed as 2.11.2, printed page 42.

blocks.text: Jab paanch valence electrons wale impurity atoms, jaise phosphorus, khalis semiconductor mein dale jate hain to kuch silicon atoms ki jagah pentavalent phosphorus atoms le lete hain. Un ke gird ke silicon atoms chaar bandhan bana sakte hain, aur impurity ka paanchwan electron ek izafi electron hai. Yeh impurity atoms crystal lattice ko izafi electrons dete hain, jo harkat ke liye azad hain aur manfi charge carriers ka kaam karte hain. Nateeja N-type semiconductor hai jo bairooni source se jorne par bijli conduct karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Arsenic (group 15) aur gallium (group 13) dono germanium ko dope karne mein istemal hote hain. Kaun sa n-type aur kaun sa p-type deta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Arsenic ke paanch valence electrons hain, germanium ke chaar bandhanon se ek zyada, to woh ek azad electron deta hai: n-type. Gallium ke teen hain, ek kam, to woh ek hole chhorta hai: p-type.

items: Pentavalent impurities (P, As) paanchwan electron lati hain jo harkat ke liye azad hai, manfi carrier: n-type semiconductor.
